headline: Prime Focus Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Namit Malhotra filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding substantial acquisition of shares in Prime Focus Limited. The filing signals a material shareholding trigger event under SEBI takeover norms.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures mark the formal regulatory notification of a 5% threshold breach or concert-party aggregation; precedent-tracking partners must cross-check the actual stake acquired, concert relationships, and any mandatory open offer obligation threshold (25% under the 2011 Regulations).
detail: Namit Malhotra submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation requires acquirers to disclose shareholding patterns and concert-party relationships when a 5% substantial acquisition threshold is breached. The filing indicates a material corporate action in Prime Focus Limited, a technology-sector listed entity. Specific stake size, consideration, and concert relationships are not disclosed in the headline; the full PDF filing would contain these particulars.
